# APPENDIX D

*Cross-reference: Chapter 20 (Quiet Logic Problem) “You cannot prove that nothing happened” \| Coordinates with Appendix F (FRIA Section H), Appendix E (Agent Registry) and the current AI Audit and Due Diligence Checklist (Section 0 and Section 5)*

## How to Use This Template

Every governance decision rests on assumptions. The training data was representative of the deployment population. The vendor’s evaluation results transfer to this operating environment. The escalation path will work when escalation is needed. The user reading the AI’s output will understand it as a recommendation rather than a conclusion. Each of these is a load-bearing claim. Each of them can fail. The Assumption Register is the operational artifact that names them, attaches them to the human who carries Final Liability for them, defines how each is tested and records what happens when one fails.

Per Chapter 20, audit-grade evidence is evidence of process: presence of a design that identified risks and made documented trade-offs. An assumption that has not been named cannot be tested. An assumption that has not been tested is a risk hidden inside a decision. The Register makes the hidden risks visible so the governance function can decide which to accept, which to mitigate and which require the deployment to be reconsidered.

For each assumption: complete all fields. Do not leave fields blank. Where a field is not applicable, state the basis for non-applicability. The Register is reviewed by the named system owner at the cadence recorded in D11; status changes (Active, Watch, Falsified, Superseded, Retired) are recorded in D14 with the date and the human who made the determination. A Falsified assumption is not deleted. It is retained in the Register with its falsification record, because the governance trail that demonstrates the organization detected and responded to the failure is itself evidence.

This template is synchronized with Appendix F (FRIA Section H residual risk and review triggers), Appendix E (Agent Registry trust boundary specification) and the AI Audit and Due Diligence Checklist in Appendix I. Where an assumption is also recorded in another instrument, cross-reference rather than restate; the Register is the system of record for assumption status.

## Field Schema

| **Section D │ Per-Assumption Fields** *One row per assumption. Fields D1-D14 are mandatory. New rows appended as assumptions are named.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Field**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **D1 Assumption ID** Unique identifier for the assumption within this Register. ID format must support cross-reference from FRIA Section D, Agent Registry trust boundary specification and audit checklist responses. Once issued, an ID is never reassigned even after the assumption is Retired.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **D2 Assumption Domain** Domain of the assumption. Select one: Data (training, fine-tuning, retrieval); Model (capability, behavior, limits); Environment (deployment context, integration); User (population, capability, intent); Downstream (effect on third parties, systems, rights); Regulatory (interpretation of legal duty); Vendor (supplier capability, support, supply chain); Operational (oversight, escalation, monitoring). Domain determines the test regime and which Three Lines function carries primary monitoring responsibility. |
| **D3 Assumption Statement** The assumption stated in declarative, falsifiable form. Not aspirational. Not a value statement. The standard is whether a competent independent reviewer can determine, from the statement alone, what observable condition would falsify it. A statement that cannot be falsified is not an assumption. It is a belief, and beliefs do not belong in the Register.                                                                                                                                                        |
| **D4 Source / Basis** The evidence on which the assumption rests. Examples: vendor model card field reference; internal evaluation result with date; regulatory text or guidance citation; expert determination with name and qualification; pilot data with sample size and confidence interval. A statement of the source is required even where the source is the assessor’s judgment; in that case the basis field records the reasoning.                                                                                                           |
| **D5 Named Owner** The named human who carries Final Liability for this assumption. Not a function title. Not a committee. A specific person with the authority to declare the assumption Falsified and to trigger the consequences. Where the system owner in Appendix E is the same person, cross-reference. Where it is not, record both and the basis for the split.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **D6 Confidence Level** High, Medium or Low, with a brief rationale. Confidence is recorded so that a Low-confidence assumption supporting a high-impact decision is visible as a risk concentration. Confidence is not the same as severity. A High-confidence assumption can still be falsified.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **D7 Risk if False** What is exposed if the assumption fails. Identify: which right, system or stakeholder is affected; whether the harm is direct or indirect; whether the harm is reversible; the regulatory or contractual exposure that follows. This field connects the assumption to FRIA Section D rights-impact analysis where applicable; cross-reference rather than restate.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **D8 Test or Verification Method** How the assumption is checked. Examples: scheduled re-evaluation against held-out data; monitoring metric with threshold; vendor attestation with refresh cadence; user research at defined intervals; regulatory guidance review on publication. The method must be sufficient to detect falsification before material harm accrues; if not, the assumption is high-residual-risk and must be flagged for E5 of the FRIA.                                                                                           |
| **D9 Falsification Trigger** The observable condition that invalidates the assumption. Stated in advance, not after the fact. Without a pre-defined trigger, falsification becomes a judgment call after the system has already produced consequences, which is the governance failure the Register exists to prevent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **D10 Response on Falsification** What happens when the trigger fires. Steps include, at minimum: notification of the named owner and the appropriate Three Lines functions; assessment of whether the system’s continued operation remains within its authorized trust boundary (Appendix E); FRIA review trigger if applicable (Appendix F H5); incident classification and Art. 73 notification assessment for serious incidents; change management initiation if the assumption supported a deployment-permitting determination.                    |
| **D11 Monitoring Cadence** How often the assumption is re-tested. Cadence must be proportionate to volatility of the underlying basis and to the impact classification of the system. Continuous (real-time monitoring metric); per-decision; daily; weekly; monthly; quarterly; on-event-only. Cadence is itself reviewed at each governance review of the Register.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **D12 Status** Active (in force, monitored at cadence); Watch (signal observed that may indicate falsification, increased monitoring in effect); Falsified (trigger fired, response in progress or completed); Superseded (replaced by a new assumption that captures the relevant claim more accurately); Retired (system no longer relies on this assumption). Status changes are recorded in D14.                                                                                                                                                    |
| **D13 Related Artifacts** Cross-references to: Appendix E (Agent Registry entry ID); Appendix F (FRIA Section / Field); Appendix I (Audit Checklist question numbers); Appendix J (GRC Master Reference principle or part); model card field; vendor contract clause; internal policy document. The Register is a node in the governance graph; the value of the Register is in its connection to the rest of the architecture.                                                                                                                         |
| **D14 Change Log** Versioned record of when the assumption was added, modified, status-changed or retired, by whom and on what basis. Entries are not deleted. The Change Log is the audit trail that demonstrates the Register operated as a control rather than as a static document.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## Worked Example

| **Worked Example │ Assumption Register Entry** *Illustrative entry for a Tier-1 customer-service triage system*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Field**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **D1 Assumption ID** ASR-2026-014                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **D2 Assumption Domain** Model                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **D3 Assumption Statement** The deployed model’s false-negative rate on complaint classifications involving regulated harm categories (financial loss, discriminatory treatment, safety hazard) does not exceed 2 percent at the chosen operating threshold.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **D4 Source / Basis** Vendor evaluation report dated 12 March 2026, Section 4.3, n=8,400 held-out cases representative of the deployment population by category and language. Internal pilot evaluation 1-21 April 2026, n=1,200, false-negative rate observed 1.6 percent (95 percent CI: 1.0-2.4 percent).                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **D5 Named Owner** Jane Doe, Director of Customer Operations (system owner of record per Appendix E entry AGR-CS-007).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **D6 Confidence Level** Medium. Pilot sample is small relative to deployment volume; CI overlaps the threshold. Confidence elevated to High after first 90 days of production monitoring if metric holds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **D7 Risk if False** Regulated harm complaints routed to the standard queue rather than the priority-review queue. Affected right: effective remedy (Charter Art. 47) for affected complainants. Indirect harm: regulator notification timeline at risk if breach reporting threshold is missed because the complaint was not surfaced. FRIA Section D row 4 cross-reference.                                                                                                           |
| **D8 Test or Verification Method** Weekly stratified sample of 200 closed complaints reviewed by independent quality assurance team (second-line). Quarterly full re-evaluation against refreshed held-out set, n\>=2,000. Continuous monitoring metric: rolling 30-day false-negative rate computed against ground-truth labels assigned within 14 days of complaint closure.                                                                                                          |
| **D9 Falsification Trigger** Either: rolling 30-day false-negative rate exceeds 2.5 percent on two consecutive weekly readings; or quarterly re-evaluation produces a point estimate above 3.0 percent or a 95 percent CI upper bound above 3.5 percent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **D10 Response on Falsification** Within 24 hours: named owner notified; second-line GRC notified; oversight mode escalated from HOTL to HITL on regulated harm categories pending resolution. Within 5 business days: root-cause analysis; FRIA Section H5 review trigger initiated; Article 73 serious-incident assessment if any falsification-period complaint involved actual harm. Within 15 business days: change management decision (continue HITL, retrain, replace, retire). |
| **D11 Monitoring Cadence** Continuous (rolling 30-day metric); weekly QA sample; quarterly full re-evaluation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **D12 Status** Active.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **D13 Related Artifacts** Appendix E entry AGR-CS-007 (Agent Registry); Appendix F FRIA dated 28 March 2026, Section D row 4 and Section E1 (technical mitigation); Appendix I Audit Checklist Q67, Q72, Q104; vendor contract Schedule 3 Clause 4.2 (evaluation refresh obligation); internal AI Operations Standard v3.1 Section 5.                                                                                                                                                   |
| **D14 Change Log** v1.0 added 22 April 2026 (Jane Doe); v1.1 monitoring cadence tightened from monthly to weekly QA sample 5 May 2026 (Jane Doe, following second-line recommendation).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

**Final Liability rests with the Human.**
